'''''Wanted Poster: Princess Leia Organa''''' was a poster produced by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It depicted [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and known [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] supporter who was directly involved in the events leading to the destruction of the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]].

==Description==
''Wanted Poster: Princess Leia Organa'' depicted two images&mdash;one from the front and another from the side&mdash;of [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and known [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] sympathizer who was instrumental in the events leading to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destruction]] of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], in the [[Realspace/Legends|space]] above the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] text, the [[Writing/Legends|alphabet]] of [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]], along the top read "ALIAS: PRINCESS LEIA," while the text at the bottom read "WANTED" with the Imperial emblem in the left-bottom corner. The poster was [[Color/Legends|colored]] in shades of blue and green.<ref name="SWG" />

==History==
The poster was created and produced by the Galactic Empire sometime after the Battle of Yavin of [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a series of conflicts between the Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] were known to carry copies of the poster on their person.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Wanted Poster: Princess Leia Organa'' was a poster that appeared in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]]. It could be looted by the player from the corpses of fallen stormtroopers, along with [[Wanted Poster: Luke Skywalker|wanted]] [[Wanted Poster: Han Solo|posters]] for [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. The picture used in the poster is of the in-[[Star Wars video games|game]] model used for Organa. The player could use the poster as decoration in one of their personal structures.<ref name="SWG" />
